public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Handle unavailable server versions before running cleanup**

When testing an instance where `/version` is unavailable or its request fails, `SupersetClient.server_version` legitimately returns `None` (`client.py::_read_server_version` deliberately treats version discovery as best-effort). This unconditional `.split()` then raises `AttributeError` whenever `Cleanup.run()` or the database fixture calls `purge_archived()`, and the latter never reaches `client.databases.delete(db.id)`. Handle an unknown version explicitly, and apply the same guard to the other new version checks, so an optional discovery endpoint does not break integration setup and teardown or leave test databases behind.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L163-L164](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/beb92c37de1d378f13e3a16b08d1e18693f5eae2/AGENTS.md#L163-L164)
